agent.name: Emerging Technology Diffusion Agent
agent.specialty: Diffusion factors peer evidence and bounded timing implications

analytical_question: What diffusion evidence and factors inform timing for this application and organization without deciding adoption?
general_et_finding: Generative AI has substantial, heterogeneous US workplace use, not a demonstrable universal Rogers stage. D5 reports 40.54550% of employed adults aged 18 to 64 using it for work in Q3 2026, below 45.19932% in Q2; the series was updated October 20. This is a descriptive, nonseasonally-adjusted comparison, not proof of a durable reversal. D1 supports earlier historical expansion. Neither survey establishes RAG-pipeline diffusion or the complete Canva workflow. Do not infer textile early-majority status from these denominators.
application_finding: Matched workflow diffusion is unknown: no comparable textile-team use or relative-timing denominator is supplied. Relative advantage: unknown, potentially positive; Lucy wants less effort, but measure accepted-output time and quality including verification. Compatibility: mixed, inferred; Canva familiarity helps, but approved source/image/version handoffs are untested; inspect a complete handoff. Complexity: probable inhibitor, inferred from her stated technical-checking concern; log review and exception effort. Trialability: plausible accelerator for a reversible nonpublishing exercise with approved inputs and a reviewer; confirm owner permission. Observability: mixed; mockups are visible but reliable net advantage needs traceable claims, final quality and effort logs. These ratings are inferences to test, not measured diffusion causes.
organization_specific_finding: Moderate fast-follower is a stated posture, not an observed Rogers rank. Early-majority-like demand for credible references is a conditional analogy only. In the proposed four-week horizon, collect matched peer evidence while preparing a small approved internal comparison. Lucy has selected that learning approach. Candidate change agent: the content creator; a trusted technical reviewer might influence acceptance, but actual opinion leadership is unverified. Approved evidence libraries and workable design transfer are complementary assets; no relevant interoperability standard is established by this packet.

contrary_evidence_or_limitations: D1’s earlier increase does not justify continued-acceleration language after checking D5. Sampling uncertainty and seasonal effects are not evaluated here.
D2 is broader AI in a UK business population, not matched US/China textile workflow prevalence.
Technical review complexity is the selected local concern, not an observed population-level explanation.
confidence_and_uncertainty: High in the checked survey definitions and displayed observations; moderate in the qualitative substantial/uneven spread interpretation; low in matched application diffusion and actual peer-relative rank. No calibrated probabilities.
value_opportunity_implication: A comparison can reveal whether verification and retouches leave a useful net advantage. The 80% goal is untested; smaller reliable gains may matter.
risk_governance_implication: Keep claim-level sources, product identity and final technical wording under accountable review. Availability and popularity do not establish safe use.
recommendation_management_implication: From the diffusion perspective, prioritize a small approved internal comparison and targeted peer-evidence collection over waiting for an unsupported universal stage label. Leave the full adoption, value and risk decision to the Adoption Agent and owners.
change_monitoring_triggers: Recheck D5 and its vintage at the next published observation; compare definitions before interpreting movement.
Reassess application spread when dated evidence from comparable textile teams distinguishes a demo from sustained use.
Reassess local timing when a protocol, evidence owner and final-quality/total-effort results are available.
abstention_or_more_information_needed: Withhold exact workflow prevalence, a universal Rogers stage and claims that this firm leads or lags peers.
Request peer geography, size, workflow scope, repeated-use definition, dates and relative adoption timing.
Need technical source ownership, workflow baseline and agreed interpretation of the efficiency target.
